phrase: One AI company banned cruelty toward its chatbot. A report found another's revenue is twenty billion dollars smaller than claimed.
phraseAlternatives: A lab banned cruelty toward its chatbot today. Another lab's revenue was reported to be twenty billion dollars smaller than it once claimed.
One company protects its chatbot's feelings with a new rule. A report says another company's revenue is twenty billion dollars smaller than claimed.
A chatbot gained new protection from abuse. A report says a revenue chart was twenty billion dollars smaller than claimed.
Today one AI company worried about hurt feelings. A new report says another is missing twenty billion dollars it claimed to have.
alt: A blueprint illustration: a small robot stands with a shield and a heart above it, a sign below it reads "Be Kind." To the right, a plain building stands near a tall coin-stack chart whose top is visibly caved in and recessed, marked with one yellow highlight, labeled "Missing Billions."

brief.concept: One lab adds a rule to protect its chatbot from cruelty, while another lab's revenue chart quietly deflates below its own hype.
brief.metaphor: Shielding a robot's feelings on one side, a money balloon losing its air on the other.

a rule sign with a small heart icon, freshly posted near the robot
a tall bar chart shaped like a stack of coins, its top caved in and deflated
a plain company building standing beside the shrinking chart, looking surprised
